title: Central Omega Resources Reports Record Production and Profit Surge in H1 2025
body: PT Central Omega Resources Tbk reported a 140% jump in nickel ore production to 1.73 Mt and a 159% rise in sales to 1.83 Mt in the first half of 2025, driving net profit to Rp310.3 bn and EBITDA to Rp481.4 bn. The company attributes the surge to the full resumption of mining operations under a new 2024 RKAB, remains optimistic for the rest of 2025 amid stable global nickel prices, but cautions about potential US tariff uncertainties while pursuing new reserves and operational efficiencies.

title: Indonesia's Nickel Prices Rise in Early October 2025, APNI Calls for Market-Reflective Adjustments
body: The Indonesian Nickel Association (APNI) reported that nickel benchmark prices rose to US$15,101.67 per dmt in the first half of October 2025, up from US$15,000.33 in the second half of September, with reference prices ranging from US$28.75 to over US$44 per wmt depending on grade and moisture content. APNI urged the government to adjust the benchmark to better reflect market realities, especially for low‑grade domestic miners, and reaffirmed its commitment to advocate for fair, sustainable pricing.

title: Merdeka Battery's Nickel Ore Production Surges 78% in H1 2025 Amid Smelter Maintenance and Strategic MHP Sales
body: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk. reported a 78% YoY jump in nickel ore production to 6.9 Mt wmt in the first half of 2025, driven by 45% growth in limonite and 189% in saprolite, while its smelter RKEF maintenance cut downstream NPI output by 23% to 33,045 t but lowered cash costs to $9,719/ton. The company also sold 9,465 t of mixed hydroxide precipitate via ESG New Energy’s Train A, is advancing a 90,000 t/yr HPAL at Sulawesi Nickel Cobalt (29% complete, commissioning mid‑2026), and is building two FPPs and a slurry pipeline to HPAL Morowali, with EBITDA at $77 M (down 8% YoY) but a 33% YoY rise in Q2 after HGNM cuts.
